name: Into the Mists
summary: The road you were on is gone. The mist has delivered you somewhere else: a dark valley, a wolf-haunted road and a village at the end of it.

stages.journal: Fog rolled over the road and did not roll back. When it thinned, the road behind us had become a wall of white that turns us around whenever we walk into it. The only way is forward.
A wolf pack held the narrows of the road and watched us like sentries, not hunters. We got past them. Someone, somewhere, now knows we are here.
objectives: Follow the road to the village

stages.journal: Past the headless statues of a stone gate, the road brought us to the edge of a village. Two children were waiting in the road, as if for us.
